fact: UNFPA, the National Institute of Statistics (INE) and the Ministry of Justice and Human Rights ran a five-day descriptive statistics training (4-8 August 2025, Bissau) for 42 professionals, including civil registry technicians from all nine regions, to improve the accuracy of vital statistics.

The Instituto Nacional de Estatísticas yearbook of vital statistics for 2018-2022 draws on paper civil-registration records of births, marriages and deaths held by the Ministry of Justice (databases sent to INE annually in Excel), with the RapidPro birth-registration platform, and on the DHIS2 health information system for deaths and causes; as_of is the document's published date (2022-01-01), the figures cover 2018-2022.
